newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, posts new contract lows.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, posts new contract lows.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed on Friday after notching new contract lows across the board except for spot December.
Traders noted that spread activity was the main feature of the session.
The December/March spread was noted, which widened out early.

"General Mills bought about 2.5 million of the December over the March at 26 to 27 cents a bushel," a trader said. "Shay Grain also came after the Dec/March spread and bought about one million of the December/March," he added. CIS sold about 1.5 to 2.0 million bushels March wheat.
Then late in the session mixed trading occurred.
"We had some selling and locals ran prices down to new lows," he said.
KCBT December wheat firmed 1-1/2 cents to $4.27-3/4 with other months off 1/4 to up one cent.
